author: Davidgo5867

english.text: They are the essence of our differences with communism today. I am unalterably opposed to communism because it exalts the state over the individual and the family, and because of the lack of freedom of speech, of protest, of religion, and of the press, which is the characteristic of totalitarian states. The way of opposition to communism is not to imitate its dictatorship, but to enlarge individual freedom, in our own countries and all over the globe.

text: 佢哋係我哋今時今日同共產主義嘅分歧嘅本質。我無可改變地反對共產主義，因為佢將國家高舉過個人同家庭，同埋因為佢缺乏言論、抗議、宗教同新聞自由，而呢個係極權國家嘅特點。反對共產主義嘅方法唔係模仿佢嘅獨裁，而係擴大個人自由，喺我哋自己嘅國家同全球各地。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Before noon today, I walked, returning to Tim Hortons café to drink a Vanilla Cream Cold Brew with oat milk. I introduced myself to Ken, who wore a dazzling white-on-black T-shirt with the word "GORILLAZ" and a drawing of a face on it. He said that his daughter brought it from her trip to Japan. Ken, I think, is a motorcyclist because he carried a helmet and had a black leather jacket. On my way home, I noticed everywhere the profusion of wild dandelions with their yellow blooms and already white seed puffs.

text: 今日中午之前，我行咗，返去 Tim Hortons café 飲咗一杯香草忌廉冷釀配埋燕麥奶。我向 Ken 介紹自己，佢着住件令人眼花繚亂嘅白底黑字 T 恤，上面寫住「 GORILLAZ 」呢個字，上面仲有一幅面孔嘅畫。佢話佢個女喺佢去日本旅行嗰陣帶咗嚟。我諗 Ken 係個電單車手，因為佢戴住個頭盔同埋着住件黑色嘅皮褸。返屋企嘅路上，我留意到到處都係野生蒲公英，佢哋嘅黃色花朵同已經係白色嘅種子泡芙。
